basic_info.description: 1840 Washington is a Pacific Heights, state-of-the-art, boutique, steel-frame building constructed in 2012. Considered the best floor plan in the building due to the additional width, this unit has gorgeous maple floors and a sunny south-facing deck. The exceptional kitchen has Studio Becker cabinets, Cesarstone counters, Bosch gas range and eating bar. Two bedrooms have spa-like ensuite baths with Ann Saks tile. Primary bedroom has a deep Bay window, perfect for a home office desk. Excellent closet space overall plus the much beloved large deeded storage room directly across from your front door. In-unit washer and dryer and parking on the preferred main level. The heat is by a European radiant heat system paid for by the dues. Common view roof deck with sweeping north views of the City and the Bay. Steps from all the dining, entertainment and amenities of the upper Polk corridor plus Whole Foods, this is a great opportunity.
